author: James Scott
title: Nocturnal II Shifts to Metroidvania Format for November 10 Release - NewsBreak
text:
By James Scott ,
1 days ago Nocturnal II is developed and published by the Swiss-based studio Sunnyside Games. The title returns players to the role of Ardeshir. The core of the gameplay remains centered on the “Enduring Flame” system. To survive the hazards of the dark, Ardeshir must strike fire sources to ignite his sword. This flame is not merely for offense; it is essential for clearing the lethal mist that blankets the world and for interacting with environmental puzzles. Players are tasked with physically maintaining their light source, as many areas remain inaccessible or deadly without an active flame. Read full article
